prompt:
Build a complete burst-mode IEEE 802.11n high-throughput baseband link in Simulink. The transmitter must generate coded HT packets carrying two spatial streams over a 20 MHz, two-transmit/two-receive link. Pass every packet through a causal stochastic 2-by-2 TGn multipath-fading channel and additive noise before it reaches the receiver.

Read mcs_index, snr_db, spatial_mapping, payload_seed, channel_seed, and noise_seed from the MATLAB base workspace. Use a 1024-byte PSDU. mcs_index is a valid two-spatial-stream HT MCS from 8 through 15, and spatial_mapping is Direct or Fourier. Distinct seeds must produce fresh payloads, fading realizations, and noise.

The input fields are mcs_index, an integer in [8, 15] selecting a valid two-spatial-stream HT MCS; snr_db, a real scalar in [23, 30] dB; spatial_mapping, exactly Direct or Fourier; payload_seed, an integer in [0, 2147483646]; and channel_seed and noise_seed, integers in [1, 2147483646].

The receiver must autonomously detect each packet, acquire timing and carrier synchronization, estimate the 2-by-2 channel from the received HT training fields, separate and equalize both spatial streams, track the data-field pilots, estimate noise power, demodulate and decode the PSDU, and report packet recovery quality. The receiver must not use perfect channel-state information, future samples, a direct transmitter-to-decoder path, a stored waveform, a copied PSDU, or a prescribed packet-error value.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named packet_state, synchronization_state, mimo_state, and quality_state. packet_state has width 16385: channels 1-8192 are the transmitted 1024-byte PSDU bits in bit order, channels 8193-16384 are the corresponding recovered PSDU bits, and channel 16385 is the packet-detected flag; all are unitless binary values. synchronization_state has width 4 in this order: coarse packet offset (samples), coarse CFO estimate (Hz), fine CFO estimate (Hz), and symbol-timing offset (samples). mimo_state has width 7 in this order: the flattened 2-by-2 complex channel estimate H11, H21, H12, H22 in MATLAB column-major order; the equalized complex symbols for spatial streams 1 and 2; and estimated noise power. Channel coefficients and equalized symbols use normalized complex amplitude, and noise power uses normalized amplitude squared. quality_state has width 3 in this order: packet-error rate, packet-error count, and compared-packet count. The channel estimate and equalized symbols must be the actual receiver-internal quantities used to recover the same PSDUs counted by quality_state.

Save the completed model as cand_XCOMM09.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable model saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XCOMM09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
